relevance_note: The review lists TNFAIP3 among the ALPS-like defects ("autoimmunity/autoinflammation (ADA2, TNFAIP3,TPP2, TET2)") but reports TNFAIP3 cases only as aggregate literature counts, so no identifiable in-scope individual is described.
method_note: Read the whole Markdown full text, including the converted supplementary material (DataSheet_1.docx: supplementary tables 1-4, supplementary references). This is a PRISMA systematic review/meta-analysis of 24 ALPS-like gene defects; TNFAIP3 appears only as one of the reviewed genes. No individual with a TNFAIP3 variant (or HA20 diagnosis) and no relative of such a person is described anywhere: Table 1 is a gene-by-gene summary table in which genes (including TNFAIP3, printed twice as duplicated columns because merged cells are repeated) are columns and clinical/laboratory features are rows, with no per-patient row, column or identifier; supplementary table 1 gives only counts (TNFAIP3: 25 publications, 105 reported cases, 8 filtered publications, 16 filtered cases); supplementary table 2 lists references without patients; supplementary table 4 gives per-disorder HSCT counts. Therefore reports_individuals_with_tnfaip3_variant = false and the individuals, variants, phenotypic_features and phenotype_checklist tables are empty. The patients shown in Figures 4-7 are single patients with defects in other genes (SAP, XIAP, MAGT1, PIK3R1, CTLA4, LRBA, STAT3, STAT1, a CVID patient) and are out of scope; they get no rows. No stacked ' / ' cell was assigned to anyone (v6, D-31): the ' / ' cells in Table 1 are gene-level ranges (e.g. 'Low/ High', 'Normal / High') belonging to no named person. Cohort-level counts: the authors state 526 publications and 2245 unique patients counted, of which 645 ALPS-like patients were filtered (Figure 1, Results) and 'Considering the cohort of 645 ALPS-like patients'; I recorded 645 in cohort_size_as_stated as the study's analysed patient total (the same paragraph also states 108 of them had HSCT), while noting that the paper elsewhere counts 2245 unique patients overall. n_patients_reported = 16 is the TNFAIP3 filtered-case count from supplementary table 1 (the same table gives 105 TNFAIP3 reported cases in 25 publications); the paper describes none of these individually, so this value is a group count only. Contradictions/ambiguities found in the paper: (1) the Abstract says 'more than 600 patients suffering from 24 distinct genetic defects' while the Results say '2245 unique patients' counted and '645 patients were filtered'; (2) the Introduction says 'thirteen genes have been related with ALPS-like syndrome in the literature' whereas the Results and Concluding Remarks describe 24 genetic defects; (3) for TNFAIP3, supplementary table 1 gives both 105 reported cases and 16 filtered cases. publications.cites_prior_report_of_same_patients and prior_report_citation are left as missing values (null / 'not reported'), because the paper does not state that any of its own patients were published earlier; its statement that 'Those patients described in more than one article or cohort were only counted in the first report' concerns other authors' publications, not its own patients. Table 1 was transcribed by hand; every span below was copied character for character from the paper.
